sizing_guide.title: How to Accurately Size Your Generator: The Definitive Electrical Guide
sizing_guide.intro: Proper generator sizing is critical for site reliability and fuel economy. An undersized unit will experience voltage collapse, overheating, and frequent breaker trips under motor startup surges; an oversized unit operates inefficiently and risks "wet stacking" (carbon and unburnt fuel accumulation in the exhaust manifold).
sizing_guide.calc_title: Accounting for Motor In-Rush Current & Inductive Loads
sizing_guide.calc_description: Electric motors, HVAC compressors, dewatering pumps, and crane hoists require significantly higher starting current than their continuous running wattage. Direct-On-Line (DOL) motors demand 6x to 8x full-load current at start; Star-Delta starters draw 3x to 4x; while Variable Frequency Drives (VFD) draw 1.2x to 1.5x. Our electrical engineering team calculates starting kVA (SkVA) and applies a 0.8 power factor multiplier to guarantee zero voltage dips during peak startup.
sizing_guide.fuel_title: High Ambient Temperature & Desert Deration Factors
sizing_guide.fuel_description: Under UAE summer conditions where ambient temperatures routinely exceed 45°C to 50°C, engine combustion air density drops and cooling performance diminishes. Standard ISO 3046 ratings are calibrated for 25°C; operating above this requires technical derating of 3% to 5% per 5°C. Generator Dubai supplies heavy-duty high-ambient tropical radiators and oversized alternators so your equipment consistently delivers 100% of its rated capacity even in extreme mid-summer heat.
applications_chart_items: 50–100 kVA: Commercial site offices, lighting towers, security cabins, and residential backup.

mistakes_items: Sizing purely on running kW without evaluating peak inductive motor starting spikes (SkVA).
Running diesel engines below 30% rated load for extended periods, causing cylinder bore glazing.
Failing to adjust for ambient summer heatwaves exceeding 50°C in open desert job sites.
Ignoring non-linear harmonic distortion from large variable frequency drives (VFD) and server UPS units.

overview.title: What is an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for Generators?
overview.paragraph_1: An Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) is a comprehensive service agreement between your facility and our certified power generation engineering team. Rather than waiting for an emergency failure during a municipal power cut, an AMC establishes rigorous monthly, bi-monthly, or quarterly preventive maintenance routines that identify and rectify electrical, mechanical, and thermal anomalies before they result in costly downtime.
overview.paragraph_2: Operating in the UAE's harsh desert environment exposes diesel generating sets to ambient temperatures exceeding 50°C, extreme humidity, and fine sand particulate contamination. Our AMC contracts include computerized ECM diagnostic health scans, oil spectrometry degradation analysis, ASTM fuel testing, battery conductance monitoring, and automated transfer switch (ATS) testing to ensure your standby system starts within 10 seconds of grid failure.
features: Scheduled monthly, bi-monthly, or quarterly 50-point technical inspection visits
24/7/365 priority emergency breakdown dispatch with guaranteed response times
Replacement of engine lube oil, oil filters, fuel filters, water separators, and air filters
Coolant chemistry testing, inhibitor dosing, and radiator pressure cap checks
Battery conductance testing, terminal cleaning, and trickle-charger calibration
Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) contactor cleaning, timing check, and mock blackout simulation
Civil Defense annual maintenance logbook certification and insurance compliance reports

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Generator Maintenance

items.question: How often should a standby generator be serviced in the UAE?
items.answer: Even if a standby generator is rarely run, the extreme heat, humidity, and airborne sand degrade engine oil, battery plates, and rubber hoses. Standby units should undergo preventive servicing every 3 months or every 250 operating hours, whichever comes first.

items.question: What is included in a typical 250-hour service?
items.answer: A 250-hour service includes draining and replacing engine lubricating oil with synthetic heavy-duty oil, replacing engine oil filters, primary and secondary fuel filters, inspecting air filters, checking coolant levels and anti-freeze inhibitors, testing battery voltage, and performing a test run.

items.question: Why won’t my generator start automatically when the power fails?
items.answer: The most frequent culprits in the UAE are dead or sulfur-calcified starter batteries, faulty battery trickle chargers, an uncalibrated Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) controller, or airlocks in the diesel fuel line. Our technicians diagnose and resolve starting failures quickly.

items.question: Do you provide temporary loaner generators during major repairs?
items.answer: Yes. If your generator requires a workshop overhaul or major crankshaft repairs, we can supply a temporary rental replacement generator from our fleet at heavily discounted rates so your facility suffers zero downtime.

sizing_guide.title: How Generator Capacity Is Determined — Sizing Guide
sizing_guide.description: Accurately sizing a generator prevents premature engine wear, avoids overload tripping, and reduces unnecessary fuel expenditure.

steps.title: Inventory Running vs. Starting Loads
steps.description: List all equipment wattage. Motors, chillers, and pumps draw 3x to 5x their rated running amperage upon initial motor startup.

steps.title: Convert kW to kVA (Power Factor)
steps.description: Divide total kilowatts by 0.8 (standard three-phase power factor): kVA = Total kW / 0.8. A 160 kW load requires a 200 kVA generator minimum.

steps.title: Account for Ambient Heat Derating
steps.description: In UAE summer conditions where ambient temperatures surpass 45°C, engines require a 5%–10% safety headroom derating factor.

steps.title: Target 70%–80% Optimal Duty Loading
steps.description: Running a diesel generator below 30% causes wet-stacking; running near 100% causes thermal stress. A 75% steady load is optimal.

sizing_guide.tip: Our electrical engineers conduct free on-site load audits with clamp meters to determine exact peak and in-rush demands before quote submission.

sizing_guide.title: How to Size Your Portacabin & Site Power Requirements
sizing_guide.description: Key technical steps to determine the optimal cabin floor plan, air conditioning tonnage, and auxiliary generator kVA.

steps.title: Determine Headcount & Functional Zones
steps.description: Calculate 4–5 sq. meters per desk worker. Identify needs for private manager cabins, meeting conference tables, or pantry areas.

steps.title: Size Air Conditioning Tonnage for Desert Heat
steps.description: Allow 1 Ton of cooling per 100–120 sq. ft. in UAE summer. A 40ft cabin requires two 2-Ton or 2.5-Ton tropical split A/C units.

steps.title: Calculate Electrical Connected Load
steps.description: Sum watts for split A/Cs, LED lighting, computers, water dispensers, and microwave ovens: typical 40ft cabin = 8–12 kW.

steps.title: Match Integrated Generator Capacity
steps.description: Multiply total kW by 1.5 to accommodate A/C compressor motor starting inrush. A 20–30 kVA generator powers a multi-cabin compound.

sizing_guide.tip: Our technical team supplies AutoCAD layout drawings with single-line electrical diagrams before dispatch, ensuring your site office meets local municipal and safety guidelines.

items.question: How quickly can a portacabin be delivered and installed on site?
items.answer: Standard in-stock units (10ft guard cabins, 20ft and 40ft site offices) can be mobilized and delivered via our flatbed crane trucks within 24 to 48 hours across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah.

items.question: Do the portacabins come equipped with air conditioners and electrical wiring?
items.answer: Yes. All our rental portacabins arrive fully equipped with high-BTU tropical split air conditioners (O-General or Gree), complete concealed electrical wiring, British-standard 3-pin power outlets, and an ELCB-protected distribution board ready to plug into a power source.

items.question: Can you supply a generator to power the portacabins if there is no grid electricity?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer complete bundled packages that include a whisper-silent diesel generator (typically 20 kVA to 50 kVA depending on cabin count), fuel tanks, connection cabling, and scheduled diesel replenishment.

items.question: Do you provide furniture and plumbing for ablution cabins?
items.answer: Yes. We offer fully furnished options including executive desks, swivel chairs, conference tables, and filing cabinets. For ablution restroom cabins, we supply all sanitary fixtures, water heaters, and can provide external fresh water tanks and waste holding tanks.

items.question: What site preparation is required before the crane delivers the cabin?
items.answer: The site should have clear flat access for a 40ft flatbed crane truck, and a reasonably level, compacted ground area (concrete pad, asphalt, compacted gravel, or wooden sleeper blocks) where the cabin will be positioned.

overview.title: What is a Temporary Multi-Megawatt Power Plant?
overview.paragraph_1: A temporary power plant is an engineered, high-capacity electrical generation system composed of multiple heavy-duty containerized diesel generating sets coupled through digital synchronizing switchboards, step-up transformers, and automated fuel replenishment networks. It functions as an autonomous, utility-grade power station delivering reliable base-load, peak-shaving, or emergency standby power where permanent municipal grid connections are delayed, insufficient, or undergoing scheduled maintenance.
overview.paragraph_2: Our temporary power plants in the UAE are engineered for extreme desert ambient temperatures exceeding 50°C. Utilizing Cummins QSK60 and Perkins 4016 series industrial engines, our modular power blocks scale smoothly from 2,000 kVA up to 50,000 kVA. Intelligent digital controllers automatically spin up or idle individual generators in response to real-time kilowatt demand, ensuring optimal fuel burn and zero operational interruptions.

items.question: How quickly can a 5 MW to 20 MW temporary power plant be deployed in the UAE?
items.answer: Standard modular blocks (up to 10 MW) can be mobilized from our Jebel Ali and Mussafah yards within 24 to 48 hours. Complete installation, cable termination, and commissioning typically takes 3 to 5 days depending on the transformation voltage and site civil readiness.

items.question: Can your temporary power plants synchronize directly with the utility grid (DEWA / ADDC)?
items.answer: Yes. We utilize ComAp InteliGen and Deep Sea DSE 8610 controllers equipped with motorized breaker interfaces for no-break bumpless transfer, peak-shaving parallel grid export, and automatic mains failure islanding compliant with local utility regulations.

items.question: What voltage levels can your containerized transformers step up to?
items.answer: Our package substations provide multi-tap stepped outputs including 3.3 kV, 6.6 kV, 11 kV, 22 kV, and 33 kV. Each transformer container features oil containment bunds, SF6 ring main units (RMU), vacuum circuit breakers, and calibrated protection relays.

items.question: Do you supply full fuel management and on-site operating crews?
items.answer: Yes. We provide turnkey fuel management including 50,000L double-walled bunded bulk fuel farms, automated filtration loops, and scheduled ADNOC tanker deliveries. We also staff the facility with certified electrical engineers and plant operators on 24/7 rotational shifts.

items.question: What happens if an individual generator experiences an engine fault?
items.answer: Our power plants are designed with N+1 or N+2 spinning reserve redundancy. If one generating set detects an abnormal parameter or trips, the synchronizing bus automatically commands the reserve unit to assume the load in milliseconds with zero voltage dip or blackout.

sizing_guide.title: How to Calculate Power & Cooling Equipment Requirements
sizing_guide.description: A practical framework to match your site square footage or thermal demand to the right equipment size.

steps.title: Determine Required Tonnage (TR)
steps.description: For event tents: roughly 1 TR cools 80–120 sq ft in UAE summer. For industrial spaces, calculate total sensible and latent heat gains.

steps.title: Calculate Chiller Electrical kW
steps.description: Modern air-cooled chillers consume approximately 1.1 to 1.3 kW per Ton of Refrigeration (TR). A 100 TR chiller draws approx 125 kW.

steps.title: Add Generator Starting Surge Margin
steps.description: Compressor motor startup creates severe in-rush. Size the generator at 1.8x to 2x running kW to ensure stable voltage frequency.

steps.title: Confirm Water Flow & Pressure Drop
steps.description: Ensure water circulation pumps provide 2.4 GPM per TR with adequate head pressure across flexible hose lengths.

sizing_guide.tip: Our thermal engineers provide exact computerized heat load calculations free of charge.

overview.title: What Are Turnkey Power & Cooling Services?
overview.paragraph_1: Turnkey power services integrate equipment hire, site civil works, cable engineering, safety compliance, and fuel supply into a single, cohesive project package. Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) installation and synchronization
Dedicated fuel tankers with metered ADNOC diesel delivery
Certified safety grounding, RCD protection, and lightning arrestors

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Turnkey Services

items.question: Do your technicians hold UAE electrical certifications?
items.answer: Yes, our electrical and mechanical engineers are fully certified, holding valid certifications and trained to DEWA/ADDC standards.

items.question: What is load bank testing and why is it recommended?
items.answer: Load bank testing applies controlled artificial electrical loads to verify that generators and UPS units can deliver 100% of their rated capacity without overheating or voltage collapse. It also clears carbon deposits (wet-stacking) from engines.

items.question: Can you synchronize generators with the municipal grid?
items.answer: Yes, we provide automatic synchronizing panels with peak shaving, no-break return to grid, and automatic changeover capabilities.

items.question: Do you provide temporary cable protection for public roads?
items.answer: Yes, we supply heavy-duty polyurethane cable protector ramps capable of withstanding heavy vehicular and crane traffic.

overview.title: What is a Temporary Multi-Megawatt Power Plant?
overview.paragraph_1: A temporary power plant is an engineered, high-capacity electrical generation system composed of multiple heavy-duty containerized diesel generating sets coupled through digital synchronizing switchboards, step-up transformers, and automated fuel replenishment networks. It functions as an autonomous, utility-grade power station delivering reliable base-load, peak-shaving, or emergency standby power where permanent municipal grid connections are delayed, insufficient, or undergoing scheduled maintenance.
overview.paragraph_2: Our temporary power plants in the UAE are engineered for extreme desert ambient temperatures exceeding 50°C. Utilizing Cummins QSK60 and Perkins 4016 series industrial engines, our modular power blocks scale smoothly from 2,000 kVA up to 50,000 kVA. Intelligent digital controllers automatically spin up or idle individual generators in response to real-time kilowatt demand, ensuring optimal fuel burn and zero operational interruptions.
features: Synchronized 1000 kVA – 2500 kVA ISO containerized power modules
Dual-redundant DSE 8610 / ComAp InteliGen digital load-sharing controls
Step-up containerized transformers delivering 3.3kV, 6.6kV, 11kV, 22kV, and 33kV outputs
50,000L double-walled bunded bulk fuel farms with automated centrifugal filtration
Remote SCADA telemetry with real-time fuel, kW load, harmonic distortion, and temperature tracking
Fully compliant with DEWA, ADDC, SEWA, and UAE Civil Defense safety mandates

items.question: How quickly can a 5 MW to 20 MW temporary power plant be deployed in the UAE?
items.answer: Standard modular blocks (up to 10 MW) can be mobilized from our Jebel Ali and Mussafah yards within 24 to 48 hours. Complete installation, cable termination, and commissioning typically takes 3 to 5 days depending on the transformation voltage and site civil readiness.

items.question: Can your temporary power plants synchronize directly with the utility grid (DEWA / ADDC)?
items.answer: Yes. We utilize ComAp InteliGen and Deep Sea DSE 8610 controllers equipped with motorized breaker interfaces for no-break bumpless transfer, peak-shaving parallel grid export, and automatic mains failure islanding compliant with local utility regulations.

items.question: What voltage levels can your containerized transformers step up to?
items.answer: Our package substations provide multi-tap stepped outputs including 3.3 kV, 6.6 kV, 11 kV, 22 kV, and 33 kV. Each transformer container features oil containment bunds, SF6 ring main units (RMU), vacuum circuit breakers, and calibrated protection relays.

items.question: Do you supply full fuel management and on-site operating crews?
items.answer: Yes. We provide turnkey fuel management including 50,000L double-walled bunded bulk fuel farms, automated filtration loops, and scheduled ADNOC tanker deliveries. We also staff the facility with certified electrical engineers and plant operators on 24/7 rotational shifts.

items.question: What happens if an individual generator experiences an engine fault?
items.answer: Our power plants are designed with N+1 or N+2 spinning reserve redundancy. If one generating set detects an abnormal parameter or trips, the synchronizing bus automatically commands the reserve unit to assume the load in milliseconds with zero voltage dip or blackout.

overview.title: What is an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for Generators?
overview.paragraph_1: An Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) is a comprehensive service agreement between your facility and our certified power generation engineering team. Rather than waiting for an emergency failure during a municipal power cut, an AMC establishes rigorous monthly, bi-monthly, or quarterly preventive maintenance routines that identify and rectify electrical, mechanical, and thermal anomalies before they result in costly downtime.
overview.paragraph_2: Operating in the UAE's harsh desert environment exposes diesel generating sets to ambient temperatures exceeding 50°C, extreme humidity, and fine sand particulate contamination. Our AMC contracts include computerized ECM diagnostic health scans, oil spectrometry degradation analysis, ASTM fuel testing, battery conductance monitoring, and automated transfer switch (ATS) testing to ensure your standby system starts within 10 seconds of grid failure.
features: Scheduled monthly, bi-monthly, or quarterly 50-point technical inspection visits
24/7/365 priority emergency breakdown dispatch with guaranteed response times
Replacement of engine lube oil, oil filters, fuel filters, water separators, and air filters
Coolant chemistry testing, inhibitor dosing, and radiator pressure cap checks
Battery conductance testing, terminal cleaning, and trickle-charger calibration
Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) contactor cleaning, timing check, and mock blackout simulation
Civil Defense annual maintenance logbook certification and insurance compliance reports

overview.title: What is an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for Generators?
overview.paragraph_1: An Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) is a comprehensive service agreement between your facility and our certified power generation engineering team. Rather than waiting for an emergency failure during a municipal power cut, an AMC establishes rigorous monthly, bi-monthly, or quarterly preventive maintenance routines that identify and rectify electrical, mechanical, and thermal anomalies before they result in costly downtime.
overview.paragraph_2: Operating in the UAE's harsh desert environment exposes diesel generating sets to ambient temperatures exceeding 50°C, extreme humidity, and fine sand particulate contamination. Our AMC contracts include computerized ECM diagnostic health scans, oil spectrometry degradation analysis, ASTM fuel testing, battery conductance monitoring, and automated transfer switch (ATS) testing to ensure your standby system starts within 10 seconds of grid failure.
features: Scheduled monthly, bi-monthly, or quarterly 50-point technical inspection visits
24/7/365 priority emergency breakdown dispatch with guaranteed response times
Replacement of engine lube oil, oil filters, fuel filters, water separators, and air filters
Coolant chemistry testing, inhibitor dosing, and radiator pressure cap checks
Battery conductance testing, terminal cleaning, and trickle-charger calibration
Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) contactor cleaning, timing check, and mock blackout simulation
Civil Defense annual maintenance logbook certification and insurance compliance reports

items.question: How quickly can a portacabin be delivered and installed on site?
items.answer: Standard in-stock units (10ft guard cabins, 20ft and 40ft site offices) can be mobilized and delivered via our flatbed crane trucks within 24 to 48 hours across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah.

items.question: Do the portacabins come equipped with air conditioners and electrical wiring?
items.answer: Yes. All our rental portacabins arrive fully equipped with high-BTU tropical split air conditioners (O-General or Gree), complete concealed electrical wiring, British-standard 3-pin power outlets, and an ELCB-protected distribution board ready to plug into a power source.

items.question: Can you supply a generator to power the portacabins if there is no grid electricity?

items.question: Do you provide furniture and plumbing for ablution cabins?

items.question: What site preparation is required before the crane delivers the cabin?
items.answer: The site should have clear flat access for a 40ft flatbed crane truck, and a reasonably level, compacted ground area (concrete pad, asphalt, compacted gravel, or wooden sleeper blocks) where the cabin will be positioned.

items.question: How quickly can a portacabin be delivered and installed on site?
items.answer: Standard in-stock units (10ft guard cabins, 20ft and 40ft site offices) can be mobilized and delivered via our flatbed crane trucks within 24 to 48 hours across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah.

items.question: Do the portacabins come equipped with air conditioners and electrical wiring?
items.answer: Yes. All our rental portacabins arrive fully equipped with high-BTU tropical split air conditioners (O-General or Gree), complete concealed electrical wiring, British-standard 3-pin power outlets, and an ELCB-protected distribution board ready to plug into a power source.

items.question: Do you provide furniture and plumbing for ablution cabins?

items.question: What site preparation is required before the crane delivers the cabin?
items.answer: The site should have clear flat access for a 40ft flatbed crane truck, and a reasonably level, compacted ground area (concrete pad, asphalt, compacted gravel, or wooden sleeper blocks) where the cabin will be positioned.

sizing_guide.title: How Generator Capacity Is Determined — Sizing Guide
sizing_guide.description: Accurately sizing a generator prevents premature engine wear, avoids overload tripping, and reduces unnecessary fuel expenditure.

steps.title: Inventory Running vs. Starting Loads
steps.description: List all equipment wattage. Motors, chillers, and pumps draw 3x to 5x their rated running amperage upon initial motor startup.

steps.title: Convert kW to kVA (Power Factor)
steps.description: Divide total kilowatts by 0.8 (standard three-phase power factor): kVA = Total kW / 0.8. A 160 kW load requires a 200 kVA generator minimum.

steps.title: Account for Ambient Heat Derating
steps.description: In UAE summer conditions where ambient temperatures surpass 45°C, engines require a 5%–10% safety headroom derating factor.

steps.title: Target 70%–80% Optimal Duty Loading
steps.description: Running a diesel generator below 30% causes wet-stacking; running near 100% causes thermal stress. A 75% steady load is optimal.

sizing_guide.tip: Our electrical engineers conduct free on-site load audits with clamp meters to determine exact peak and in-rush demands before quote submission.

items.question: What happens if an individual generator experiences an engine fault?

overview.paragraph_1: An Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) is a comprehensive service agreement between your facility and our certified power generation engineering team. overview.paragraph_2: Operating in the UAE's harsh desert environment exposes diesel generating sets to ambient temperatures exceeding 50°C, extreme humidity, and fine sand particulate contamination. Our AMC contracts include computerized ECM diagnostic health scans, oil spectrometry degradation analysis, ASTM fuel testing, battery conductance monitoring, and automated transfer switch (ATS) testing to ensure your standby system starts within 10 seconds of grid failure.
features: Scheduled monthly, bi-monthly, or quarterly 50-point technical inspection visits

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Generator Maintenance

items.question: How often should a standby generator be serviced in the UAE?
items.answer: Even if a standby generator is rarely run, the extreme heat, humidity, and airborne sand degrade engine oil, battery plates, and rubber hoses. Standby units should undergo preventive servicing every 3 months or every 250 operating hours, whichever comes first.

items.question: What is included in a typical 250-hour service?
items.answer: A 250-hour service includes draining and replacing engine lubricating oil with synthetic heavy-duty oil, replacing engine oil filters, primary and secondary fuel filters, inspecting air filters, checking coolant levels and anti-freeze inhibitors, testing battery voltage, and performing a test run.

items.question: Why won’t my generator start automatically when the power fails?
items.answer: The most frequent culprits in the UAE are dead or sulfur-calcified starter batteries, faulty battery trickle chargers, an uncalibrated Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) controller, or airlocks in the diesel fuel line. Our technicians diagnose and resolve starting failures quickly.

items.question: Do you provide temporary loaner generators during major repairs?
items.answer: Yes. If your generator requires a workshop overhaul or major crankshaft repairs, we can supply a temporary rental replacement generator from our fleet at heavily discounted rates so your facility suffers zero downtime.

sizing_guide.title: How Generator Capacity Is Determined — Sizing Guide
sizing_guide.description: Accurately sizing a generator prevents premature engine wear, avoids overload tripping, and reduces unnecessary fuel expenditure.

steps.title: Inventory Running vs. Starting Loads
steps.description: List all equipment wattage. Motors, chillers, and pumps draw 3x to 5x their rated running amperage upon initial motor startup.

steps.title: Convert kW to kVA (Power Factor)
steps.description: Divide total kilowatts by 0.8 (standard three-phase power factor): kVA = Total kW / 0.8. A 160 kW load requires a 200 kVA generator minimum.

steps.title: Account for Ambient Heat Derating
steps.description: In UAE summer conditions where ambient temperatures surpass 45°C, engines require a 5%–10% safety headroom derating factor.

steps.title: Target 70%–80% Optimal Duty Loading
steps.description: Running a diesel generator below 30% causes wet-stacking; running near 100% causes thermal stress. A 75% steady load is optimal.

sizing_guide.tip: Our electrical engineers conduct free on-site load audits with clamp meters to determine exact peak and in-rush demands before quote submission.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Generator Rental

items.question: How quickly can a rental generator be delivered to our site in UAE?
items.answer: For standard fleet units (up to 500 kVA), we provide same-day emergency dispatch within 2 to 4 hours across Dubai and Sharjah. Heavy containerized sets or remote sites are typically mobilized within 12 to 24 hours.

items.question: Does the rental include fuel management and cables?
items.answer: Yes. We offer fully managed turnkey packages that include heavy-duty copper trailing cables, distribution panels, external bulk fuel tanks, and scheduled automated diesel replenishment by ADNOC-approved tankers.

items.question: Are your rental generators quiet enough for weddings and film shoots?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our acoustic silent fleet features residential-grade silencers and sound-absorbing foam, operating as low as 65 to 68 dBA at 7 meters, making them ideal for high-end events, conferences, and filming.

items.question: What happens if a generator encounters an issue on site?

sizing_guide.title: How Generator Capacity Is Determined — Sizing Guide
sizing_guide.description: Accurately sizing a generator prevents premature engine wear, avoids overload tripping, and reduces unnecessary fuel expenditure.

steps.title: Inventory Running vs. Starting Loads
steps.description: List all equipment wattage. Motors, chillers, and pumps draw 3x to 5x their rated running amperage upon initial motor startup.

steps.title: Convert kW to kVA (Power Factor)
steps.description: Divide total kilowatts by 0.8 (standard three-phase power factor): kVA = Total kW / 0.8. A 160 kW load requires a 200 kVA generator minimum.

steps.title: Account for Ambient Heat Derating
steps.description: In UAE summer conditions where ambient temperatures surpass 45°C, engines require a 5%–10% safety headroom derating factor.

steps.title: Target 70%–80% Optimal Duty Loading
steps.description: Running a diesel generator below 30% causes wet-stacking; running near 100% causes thermal stress. A 75% steady load is optimal.

sizing_guide.tip: Our electrical engineers conduct free on-site load audits with clamp meters to determine exact peak and in-rush demands before quote submission.

items.question: How quickly can a 5 MW to 20 MW temporary power plant be deployed in the UAE?
items.answer: Standard modular blocks (up to 10 MW) can be mobilized from our Jebel Ali and Mussafah yards within 24 to 48 hours. Complete installation, cable termination, and commissioning typically takes 3 to 5 days depending on the transformation voltage and site civil readiness.

items.question: Can your temporary power plants synchronize directly with the utility grid (DEWA / ADDC)?
items.answer: Yes. We utilize ComAp InteliGen and Deep Sea DSE 8610 controllers equipped with motorized breaker interfaces for no-break bumpless transfer, peak-shaving parallel grid export, and automatic mains failure islanding compliant with local utility regulations.

items.question: What voltage levels can your containerized transformers step up to?
items.answer: Our package substations provide multi-tap stepped outputs including 3.3 kV, 6.6 kV, 11 kV, 22 kV, and 33 kV. Each transformer container features oil containment bunds, SF6 ring main units (RMU), vacuum circuit breakers, and calibrated protection relays.

items.question: Do you supply full fuel management and on-site operating crews?
items.answer: Yes. We provide turnkey fuel management including 50,000L double-walled bunded bulk fuel farms, automated filtration loops, and scheduled ADNOC tanker deliveries. We also staff the facility with certified electrical engineers and plant operators on 24/7 rotational shifts.

items.question: What happens if an individual generator experiences an engine fault?
items.answer: Our power plants are designed with N+1 or N+2 spinning reserve redundancy. If one generating set detects an abnormal parameter or trips, the synchronizing bus automatically commands the reserve unit to assume the load in milliseconds with zero voltage dip or blackout.

items.question: How quickly can a 5 MW to 20 MW temporary power plant be deployed in the UAE?
items.answer: Standard modular blocks (up to 10 MW) can be mobilized from our Jebel Ali and Mussafah yards within 24 to 48 hours. Complete installation, cable termination, and commissioning typically takes 3 to 5 days depending on the transformation voltage and site civil readiness.

items.question: Can your temporary power plants synchronize directly with the utility grid (DEWA / ADDC)?
items.answer: Yes. We utilize ComAp InteliGen and Deep Sea DSE 8610 controllers equipped with motorized breaker interfaces for no-break bumpless transfer, peak-shaving parallel grid export, and automatic mains failure islanding compliant with local utility regulations.

items.question: What voltage levels can your containerized transformers step up to?
items.answer: Our package substations provide multi-tap stepped outputs including 3.3 kV, 6.6 kV, 11 kV, 22 kV, and 33 kV. Each transformer container features oil containment bunds, SF6 ring main units (RMU), vacuum circuit breakers, and calibrated protection relays.

items.question: Do you supply full fuel management and on-site operating crews?
items.answer: Yes. We provide turnkey fuel management including 50,000L double-walled bunded bulk fuel farms, automated filtration loops, and scheduled ADNOC tanker deliveries. We also staff the facility with certified electrical engineers and plant operators on 24/7 rotational shifts.

items.question: What happens if an individual generator experiences an engine fault?
items.answer: Our power plants are designed with N+1 or N+2 spinning reserve redundancy. If one generating set detects an abnormal parameter or trips, the synchronizing bus automatically commands the reserve unit to assume the load in milliseconds with zero voltage dip or blackout.

overview.title: What is an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for Generators?
overview.paragraph_1: An Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) is a comprehensive service agreement between your facility and our certified power generation engineering team. overview.paragraph_2: Operating in the UAE's harsh desert environment exposes diesel generating sets to ambient temperatures exceeding 50°C, extreme humidity, and fine sand particulate contamination. Our AMC contracts include computerized ECM diagnostic health scans, oil spectrometry degradation analysis, ASTM fuel testing, battery conductance monitoring, and automated transfer switch (ATS) testing to ensure your standby system starts within 10 seconds of grid failure.

items.question: How quickly can a portacabin be delivered and installed on site?
items.answer: Standard in-stock units (10ft guard cabins, 20ft and 40ft site offices) can be mobilized and delivered via our flatbed crane trucks within 24 to 48 hours across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah.

items.question: Do the portacabins come equipped with air conditioners and electrical wiring?
items.answer: Yes. All our rental portacabins arrive fully equipped with high-BTU tropical split air conditioners (O-General or Gree), complete concealed electrical wiring, British-standard 3-pin power outlets, and an ELCB-protected distribution board ready to plug into a power source.

items.question: Can you supply a generator to power the portacabins if there is no grid electricity?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer complete bundled packages that include a whisper-silent diesel generator (typically 20 kVA to 50 kVA depending on cabin count), fuel tanks, connection cabling, and scheduled diesel replenishment.

items.question: Do you provide furniture and plumbing for ablution cabins?
items.answer: Yes. We offer fully furnished options including executive desks, swivel chairs, conference tables, and filing cabinets. For ablution restroom cabins, we supply all sanitary fixtures, water heaters, and can provide external fresh water tanks and waste holding tanks.

items.question: What site preparation is required before the crane delivers the cabin?
items.answer: The site should have clear flat access for a 40ft flatbed crane truck, and a reasonably level, compacted ground area (concrete pad, asphalt, compacted gravel, or wooden sleeper blocks) where the cabin will be positioned.

sizing_guide.title: How We Plan & Engineer Your Power Infrastructure
sizing_guide.description: Our 4-step engineering protocol guarantees maximum electrical safety, harmonic stability, and cost-efficiency.

steps.title: Site Load Profiling & Harmonics Analysis
steps.description: We measure continuous kW, kVAR, non-linear harmonic loads, and motor in-rush spikes to size equipment accurately.

steps.description: We engineer optimal cable sizing to ensure voltage drops remain strictly under 3% over long horizontal runs.

steps.description: Insulation resistance (megger) checks and earth continuity testing performed before initial energization.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Turnkey Services

items.question: Do your technicians hold UAE electrical certifications?
items.answer: Yes, our electrical and mechanical engineers are fully certified, holding valid certifications and trained to DEWA/ADDC standards.

items.question: What is load bank testing and why is it recommended?
items.answer: Load bank testing applies controlled artificial electrical loads to verify that generators and UPS units can deliver 100% of their rated capacity without overheating or voltage collapse. It also clears carbon deposits (wet-stacking) from engines.

items.question: Can you synchronize generators with the municipal grid?
items.answer: Yes, we provide automatic synchronizing panels with peak shaving, no-break return to grid, and automatic changeover capabilities.

items.question: Do you provide temporary cable protection for public roads?
items.answer: Yes, we supply heavy-duty polyurethane cable protector ramps capable of withstanding heavy vehicular and crane traffic.

items.question: How often should a standby generator be serviced in the UAE?
items.answer: Even if a standby generator is rarely run, the extreme heat, humidity, and airborne sand degrade engine oil, battery plates, and rubber hoses. Standby units should undergo preventive servicing every 3 months or every 250 operating hours, whichever comes first.

items.question: What is included in a typical 250-hour service?
items.answer: A 250-hour service includes draining and replacing engine lubricating oil with synthetic heavy-duty oil, replacing engine oil filters, primary and secondary fuel filters, inspecting air filters, checking coolant levels and anti-freeze inhibitors, testing battery voltage, and performing a test run.

items.question: Why won’t my generator start automatically when the power fails?
items.answer: The most frequent culprits in the UAE are dead or sulfur-calcified starter batteries, faulty battery trickle chargers, an uncalibrated Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) controller, or airlocks in the diesel fuel line. Our technicians diagnose and resolve starting failures quickly.

items.question: Do you provide temporary loaner generators during major repairs?
items.answer: Yes. If your generator requires a workshop overhaul or major crankshaft repairs, we can supply a temporary rental replacement generator from our fleet at heavily discounted rates so your facility suffers zero downtime.

items.question: How often should a standby generator be serviced in the UAE?
items.answer: Even if a standby generator is rarely run, the extreme heat, humidity, and airborne sand degrade engine oil, battery plates, and rubber hoses. Standby units should undergo preventive servicing every 3 months or every 250 operating hours, whichever comes first.

items.question: What is included in a typical 250-hour service?
items.answer: A 250-hour service includes draining and replacing engine lubricating oil with synthetic heavy-duty oil, replacing engine oil filters, primary and secondary fuel filters, inspecting air filters, checking coolant levels and anti-freeze inhibitors, testing battery voltage, and performing a test run.

items.question: Why won’t my generator start automatically when the power fails?
items.answer: The most frequent culprits in the UAE are dead or sulfur-calcified starter batteries, faulty battery trickle chargers, an uncalibrated Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) controller, or airlocks in the diesel fuel line. Our technicians diagnose and resolve starting failures quickly.

items.question: Do you provide temporary loaner generators during major repairs?
items.answer: Yes. If your generator requires a workshop overhaul or major crankshaft repairs, we can supply a temporary rental replacement generator from our fleet at heavily discounted rates so your facility suffers zero downtime.

Resident station operations crew and electrical engineers on site

faqs.q: How does cross-border equipment mobilization from UAE to Oman work?
faqs.a: We handle the complete international logistics chain, including export manifests, border customs clearance (Bayan system), transit insurance, and heavy flatbed convoy delivery directly to your Oman project site.
